svg.aria-label: 1. The harness comes with Null. Nothing to install first. Null carries one checked version of Oh-my-pi (omp) inside the app. Your folder: It works from OMP's usual folder, ~/.omp: existing sign-ins, skills and MCP servers are used as they are. With none, run /login inside Null. Managed by OMP: Providers, subscriptions and API keys. Their availability and terms still apply. Your own copy: /harness switches to an Oh-my-pi found on PATH, then in ~/.omp/bin, ~/.opencode/bin, ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin, and back The carried version is named in Mini/Engine.toml and moves only after the repository's harness check has passed it. Apple Silicon Macs only, for now.
